messages:
grace: New hire report: after `apt install redwoodctl` they couldn't complete `redwoodctl login --profile=studio`  browser opened but the CLI never received the token.

leo: hmm, did the login flow return an error or just hang?

grace: it hung. Eventually timed out with `auth: no token received`. They tried again with `--profile=studio` and also `REDWOOD_PROFILE=studio` same result.

ash: can you run with `REDWOOD_LOG=debug`? also `redwoodctl config resolved --verbose` to see which profile resolver picked.

grace: pasted resolved output:
```
candidates:
 - /etc/xdg/redwood/profile -> name: demo-studio (system)
 - /home/nh/.config/redwood/profile -> name: studio (user)
requested_profile: studio
selected_profile: demo-studio
```

ash: interesting. So resolver selected a system-installed profile even though user asked for studio. That could cause login to attempt to write creds to /etc or use the wrong client_id which the browser token doesn't match.

leo: can you show a short auth trace?

grace: trace (trimmed):
```
[auth] starting device_code flow with client_id 'redwood-demo'
[auth] opening browser to https://auth.redwood.example/device
[auth] polling token endpoint... 30s
[auth] polling token endpoint... 60s
[auth] received 403: client_id mismatch
[auth] error: no token received
```

ash: client_id mismatch = we used demo client_id from system profile. That's why browser response didn't match. Two issues: resolver precedence and packaging shipping demo client ids in /etc.

tina: packaging note: we shipped a demo profile to /etc/xdg to help offline demos. PKG-210 created to move examples to /usr/share/redwood/examples and stop shipping active client ids.

oncall-bot: DEVEX-1300 created: "resolver honors requested profile names before path order". Assigned to cli-engineering.

leo: short-term workaround for onboarding: run `redwoodctl login --profile=studio --client-id=<your-org-client-id>` or remove/rename /etc/xdg/redwood/profile. Also explicitly set REDWOOD_CONFIG_PATH to point to your home config.

grace: new hire unblocked by renaming `/etc/xdg/redwood/profile` to `/etc/xdg/redwood/profile.disabled` then re-running login.

ash: fix plan: change resolver to if requested_profile present, scan all candidate files and prefer exact-name match; only fallback to precedence order if no exact match. Add unit tests for auth flows with conflicting client_ids. Also coordinate packaging to avoid shipping real client_id in example profiles.

leo: adding a small quickstart note: "If redwoodctl login opens a browser but CLI never receives a token, check for system-installed demo profiles in /etc/xdg which may contain demo client_ids".

grace: thanks, team. filing PR for the resolver test now. :thumbsup:
